default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1148.title: Largest bar of the session follow
E-1148.hypothesis: A bar whose range is the largest of the session so far and well above its usual size, closing near its extreme, is a burst of urgent orders (news or a large parent order); the follow-through outlasts the next minutes.

E-1149.title: Dry pullback in a VWAP-side trend
E-1149.hypothesis: When price has stayed on one side of VWAP, a counter-colour bar on thin volume is profit-taking, not reversal; the next bar breaking the pullback bar resumes the trend.

E-1150.title: Clock-hour candle follow
E-1150.hypothesis: Funds and index arbitrage desks rebalance on the hour; a clock-hour candle larger than usual for that hour, at its last bar, signals persistent flow carried into the next hour.

E-1151.title: Key reversal bar at a new session extreme
E-1151.hypothesis: A bar that sets a new session low (high) on above-normal volume yet closes in its top (bottom) part means the stops beyond the extreme were absorbed; the trapped side must cover.

E-1152.title: Return acceleration follow
E-1152.hypothesis: When the last n minutes' move is a multiple of the preceding n minutes' move in the same direction and larger than typical, flow is accelerating as followers and stops join; follow.

E-1153.title: Open-stretch fade on a turning bar
E-1153.hypothesis: A deviation from the day open beyond what is usual for the time of day tends to be partly retraced by liquidity providers; the first bar turning back toward the open is the entry.

E-1154.title: High-volume VWAP crossing
E-1154.hypothesis: A bar that crosses VWAP on above-normal volume has institutional participation behind the cross, unlike a drift through VWAP; follow the crossing bar.

E-1155.title: Previous clock-hour range break
E-1155.hypothesis: The prior hour's high and low are levels where stops sit; a close beyond them in the new hour starts a range expansion in that direction.

E-1156.title: Index breakout confirmed by a falling dollar
E-1156.hypothesis: The index breaking its recent range while the dollar falls over the same window is a risk-on move confirmed across markets (foreign inflow); unconfirmed breaks are the ones that fail.

E-1157.title: Half-hour mark range burst
E-1157.hypothesis: Scheduled data, auctions and algorithmic schedules concentrate at xx:00 and xx:30; a bar there with a far larger range than usual for that minute, closing at its extreme, carries information; follow.
